_comment: Refill for the 4 remaining 0.9 m pair13 gaps at 10 degrees per side, roi4: d090_t100_r2, r3, r4, r5 (repeat 1 already passed in the main sweep). Split out from rq3_jessica_0p9_pair13_refill_t8t10_roi4.json because that config's adaptive stop triggered at 8 degrees and skipped 10 entirely, with only roi4 present there was no roi16 ratio left to keep the worst crosstalk ratio above the stop threshold. adaptive_stop_ratio is 0 (off) here so that cannot happen again. Keep repeats 2-5 from this run when merging, discard 1 as redundant. Same calibration as rq3_jessica_0p9_pair13.json. Run: python -m rig session --guided --port COM7 --config configs/rq3_jessica_0p9_pair13_refill_t10_roi4.json --out data --tag refill
name: rq3-jessica-0p9-pair13-refill-t10-roi4
